notes.title: liteCam Android Version 5.0.0.5 Release
notes.content:
Hello liteCam Android users, 

liteCam Android Version 5.0.0.5 has been released  

Updated Features: 
- Fixed the errors in Multi-Monitor environment
- Fixed the Error where liteCam crashes when monitor resolution is changed
- Fixed the string resources


Thank you 

Best Regards,
liteCam Team

- Fixed the Error where liteCam crashes when monitor resolution is changed
